title: Group-ring methods for Alexander quandle rings
summary: For an Alexander quandle on an abelian group $G$ with automorphism $φ$, we identify its augmentation powers and nonunital commutator subalgebra with explicit ideals in the ordinary group ring over any commutative unital coefficient ring. Each left-normed augmentation power is also the span of all products with the same number of factors, independently of parenthesization. Over $\mathbb{Z}$, we determine every successive augmentation quotient for Alexander quandles on nontrivial finite cyclic groups.
